authority_and_precedence: The lane-13 DRAFT completeness rule asks to be frozen before any O/O2 table is built. It is DRAFT_PENDING_OWNER and binds nothing; the owner's od_hardware_pivot disposition (W7, 2026-09-27) registered this lane to build first DRAFT tables. This lane therefore builds tables only: no F_P, F_ion, F_S or F_att value is computed, no process is included, promoted or excluded, and no table enters hallthruster_bridge/propellants/. CLAUDE.md 'Next work' item 4 (O2/O only if items 1-3 succeed) is not changed by this file; these tables are unused until the owner promotes them.

why_it_matters_context.caveat: Free-stream values, not the delivered feed at the Hall boundary: collected-flow composition convention (ICD G-02) and wall recombination are open, so the delivered O/O2 split is TBD - requires fo_feed_state_closure / ICD G-02. Consequence for this lane: atomic-O channels (ionization, momentum transfer, excitation) are as important as the O2 channels.

unresolved_channels.priority: highest (atomic O dominates the free-stream composition; any O-containing Hall run needs it)
unresolved_channels.why_unresolved: The recommended BSR-1116 MTCS (Tayal & Zatsarinny, PRA 94, 042707 (2016), doi:10.1103/PhysRevA.94.042707) is tabulated only in the TZ2016 supplement (APS, paywalled; not accessed) and the SONG2026 supplement (not accessed). The open Itikawa & Ichimura 1990 reprint gives the Thomas & Nesbet Q_m only as a figure below about 14 eV (Fig. 4.1; read 2026-09-27), which is neither the recommended set nor covers the domain.
unresolved_channels.proposed_route: legitimate access to the SONG2026 / TZ2016 supplementary data (fo_closed_access_acquisition, owner-approved acquisition channel); otherwise a vector extraction of SONG2026 Fig. 24 (angle-integrated elastic and momentum-transfer, atomic O; figure number from the accepted manuscript) from the version of record, labelled digitized. Not attempted in v0.

unresolved_channels.channel: e + O electronic excitation (1D, 1S, 3s 5S, 3s 3S, allowed 3D; lumped remainder)
unresolved_channels.why_unresolved: BSR-1116 numbers are in the supplements (not accessed). Laher & Gilmore, JPCRD 19, 277 (1990) (open NIST reprint) gives analytic fits for > 60 profiles but was not transcribed in v0; the state list is owner decision OD-3.
unresolved_channels.proposed_route: v0.1: one table per state from LG1990 open fits (evaluated measurement) as an alternative, BSR-1116 as nominal once the supplement is legitimately obtained; headers from the Itikawa & Ichimura 1990 Table 2.1 level list.

unresolved_channels.channel: O2 excitation a1Delta_g (0.98 eV), b1Sigma_g+ (1.63 eV), Herzberg c/A'/A (6.12/6.27/6.47 eV), and above 20 eV
unresolved_channels.why_unresolved: Recommended HUANG2022 R-matrix values paywalled (ACS); TASHIRO2006 open on arXiv but figure-only as audited; SONG2026 plots only to 20 eV; the extension source above the R-matrix range is owner decision OD-6; the Herzberg states overlap the dissociation table (OD-4).
unresolved_channels.proposed_route: owner fixes OD-4 and OD-6 first; then SONG2026 supplement (legitimate access) or vector extraction of SONG2026 Figs. 8-10 (digitized) plus the OD-6 extension.

unresolved_channels.channel: O2 dissociation below 13.5 eV (via Herzberg and Schumann-Runge states)
unresolved_channels.why_unresolved: No total measurement below 13.5 eV; the built table therefore UNDER-counts dissociation at low T_e by an unquantified amount, and above 13.5 eV any dissociative-excitation table would double count (lane 13 CC-4).
unresolved_channels.proposed_route: owner decision OD-4 (accounting), then a combined table built from the chosen excitation source below a crossover and Cosby above.

unresolved_channels.why_unresolved: Laporta, Celiberto & Tennyson 2013 numeric supplement not accessed; arXiv preprint licence is read-only (no redistribution of derived tables asserted).
unresolved_channels.proposed_route: journal supplement via legitimate access; then the N2-style v = 0 -> v_f audit.

proposed_completeness_audit.status: PROPOSED (analogue of hallthruster_bridge/prereg/n2_completeness_audit_v1.json; the lane-13 DRAFT o_o2_completeness_prereg_DRAFT.json already carries the same thresholds). Nothing here is evaluated.
proposed_completeness_audit.rule: Promote an omitted process if F_P > 0.01 OR F_ion > 0.01 OR F_S_s > 0.05 anywhere in its applicable T_e domain (identical to the frozen N2 rule; thresholds are project conventions, not RFP values).

fractions.F_P: k_omit dE_omit / sum_j k_j dE_j (share of total electron inelastic power)
fractions.F_ion: nu_ions,omit k_omit / sum_j nu_ions,j k_j (share of total positive-ion production)
fractions.F_S_s: share of production or destruction of modeled species s due to the omitted channel
fractions.F_att_PROPOSED: k_att n_O2 / sum_j nu_ions,j k_j n_j (electron loss by attachment vs production by ionization); threshold TBD - owner decision OD-5

proposed_completeness_audit.domain_PROPOSED: T_e 2-30 eV (mean energy 3-45 eV); T_e 0.2-30 eV for vibrational, rotational, a/b and fine-structure channels (OD-1)
proposed_completeness_audit.ambiguity_rule_PROPOSED: upper bound below threshold -> EXCLUDE; lower bound above -> PROMOTE; threshold between bounds -> PROMOTE AS UNCERTAINTY VARIANT (N2 addendum 1)
proposed_completeness_audit.state_basis_for_F_S: OD-2. The composition grid must span the delivered-feed O/O2/N2 range from fo_feed_state_closure (free-stream range in the context block is NOT the delivered feed).
proposed_completeness_audit.what_v0_enables: F_ion for ionizing channels is evaluable against the v0 ionizing set (O, O2, DI) without the excitation denominators, as the N2 DI audit was. F_P and F_S remain PROVISIONAL until every tier-1 table (O MTCS, O excitation, O2 excitation, complete O2 dissociation) exists.
